mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_stat_event_inbox(event_id,payload) VALUES(#{eventId},#{payload}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id=event_id
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_stat_event_inbox SET processed=1 WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND processed=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_stat_endpoint(endpoint_id,request_method,route,endpoint_name,module_name) VALUES(#{endpointId},#{method},#{route},#{name},#{module}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE endpoint_name=VALUES(endpoint_name),module_name=VALUES(module_name)

INSERT INTO sys_stat_api_minute(bucket_time,endpoint_id,total_count,success_count,business_count,auth_count,system_count,http_count,unknown_count,slow_count,duration_us,max_us) VALUES(#{minute},#{endpointId},1,#{success},#{business},#{auth},#{system},#{http},#{unknown},#{slow},#{durationUs},#{durationUs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_count=total_count+VALUES(total_count),success_count=success_count+VALUES(success_count),business_count=business_count+VALUES(business_count),auth_count=auth_count+VALUES(auth_count),system_count=system_count+VALUES(system_count),http_count=http_count+VALUES(http_count),unknown_count=unknown_count+VALUES(unknown_count),slow_count=slow_count+VALUES(slow_count),duration_us=duration_us+VALUES(duration_us),max_us=GREATEST(max_us,VALUES(max_us))

INSERT INTO sys_stat_api_day(stat_day,endpoint_id,total_count,success_count,business_count,auth_count,system_count,http_count,unknown_count,slow_count,duration_us,max_us) VALUES(#{day},#{endpointId},1,#{success},#{business},#{auth},#{system},#{http},#{unknown},#{slow},#{durationUs},#{durationUs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE total_count=total_count+VALUES(total_count),success_count=success_count+VALUES(success_count),business_count=business_count+VALUES(business_count),auth_count=auth_count+VALUES(auth_count),system_count=system_count+VALUES(system_count),http_count=http_count+VALUES(http_count),unknown_count=unknown_count+VALUES(unknown_count),slow_count=slow_count+VALUES(slow_count),duration_us=duration_us+VALUES(duration_us),max_us=GREATEST(max_us,VALUES(max_us))

INSERT INTO sys_stat_login_day(stat_day,attempt_count,success_count,system_count) VALUES(#{day},1,#{loginSuccess},#{loginSystem}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempt_count=attempt_count+1,success_count=success_count+VALUES(success_count),system_count=system_count+VALUES(system_count)

INSERT INTO sys_stat_user_day(stat_day,user_id,login_count,api_count,last_active_time) VALUES(#{day},#{userId},#{loginSuccess},1,#{at}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE login_count=login_count+VALUES(login_count),api_count=api_count+1,last_active_time=GREATEST(last_active_time,VALUES(last_active_time))

INSERT INTO sys_stat_online_minute(bucket_time,sampled_at,online_users,online_sessions,active_users,peak_users) VALUES(#{minute},#{at},#{users},#{sessions},#{active},#{users}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE online_users=IF(VALUES(sampled_at)>=sampled_at,VALUES(online_users),online_users), online_sessions=IF(VALUES(sampled_at)>=sampled_at,VALUES(online_sessions),online_sessions), active_users=IF(VALUES(sampled_at)>=sampled_at,VALUES(active_users),active_users), peak_users=GREATEST(peak_users,VALUES(peak_users)),sampled_at=GREATEST(sampled_at,VALUES(sampled_at))
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.total_count),0) total,COALESCE(SUM(a.success_count),0) success, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_count-a.success_count),0) failed,COALESCE(SUM(a.slow_count),0) slow, ROUND(SUM(a.success_count)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(a.total_count),0),2) successRate, ROUND(SUM(a.duration_us)/NULLIF(SUM(a.total_count),0)/1000,2) avgMs, ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(a.max_us),0)/1000,2) maxMs, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempt_count),0) FROM sys_stat_login_day WHERE stat_day=#{beginDay}) loginAttempts, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(success_count),0) FROM sys_stat_login_day WHERE stat_day=#{beginDay}) loginSuccess, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(attempt_count-success_count),0) FROM sys_stat_login_day WHERE stat_day=#{beginDay}) loginFailed, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_stat_user_day WHERE stat_day=#{beginDay} AND login_count>0) loginUsers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_stat_user_day WHERE stat_day=#{beginDay}) activeUsers, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(c),0) FROM (SELECT SUM(total_count) c FROM sys_stat_api_minute WHERE bucket_time>=#{beginAt} AND bucket_time<#{endAt} GROUP BY bucket_time) peaks) peakMinute FROM sys_stat_api_day a WHERE a.stat_day=#{beginDay}

SELECT 'api' kind, DATE_FORMAT(a.bucket_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')CAST(a.stat_day AS CHAR) bucket, SUM(a.total_count) total,SUM(a.success_count) success,SUM(a.total_count-a.success_count) failed, ROUND(SUM(a.duration_us)/NULLIF(SUM(a.total_count),0)/1000,2) avgMs,NULL onlineUsers,NULL sessions,NULL active,NULL peak, NULL loginSuccess,NULL loginFailed FROM sys_stat_api_minutesys_stat_api_day a WHERE a.bucket_time>=#{beginAt} AND a.bucket_time<#{endAt}a.stat_day>=#{beginDay} AND a.stat_day<#{endDay} GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT 'online',DATE_FORMAT(bucket_time,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')DATE_FORMAT(bucket_time,'%Y-%m-%d') bucket, NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,ROUND(AVG(online_users),2),ROUND(AVG(online_sessions),2),ROUND(AVG(active_users),2),MAX(peak_users),NULL,NULL FROM sys_stat_online_minute WHERE bucket_time>=#{beginAt} AND bucket_time<#{endAt} GROUP BY bucket UNION ALL SELECT 'login',CAST(stat_day AS CHAR),NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,success_count,attempt_count-success_count FROM sys_stat_login_day WHERE stat_day>=#{beginDay} AND stat_day<#{endDay} ORDER BY bucket,kind

SELECT e.module_name module,SUM(a.total_count) total,SUM(a.business_count) business,SUM(a.auth_count) auth, SUM(a.system_count) system,SUM(a.http_count) http,SUM(a.unknown_count) unknown FROM sys_stat_api_day a JOIN sys_stat_endpoint e ON e.endpoint_id=a.endpoint_id WHERE a.stat_day>=#{beginDay} AND a.stat_day<#{endDay} GROUP BY e.module_name ORDER BY total DESC,e.module_name
mapper.sql: a.stat_day>=#{beginDay} AND a.stat_day<#{endDay} AND (e.route LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR e.endpoint_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT e.endpoint_id endpointId,e.route,e.request_method method,e.endpoint_name name,e.module_name module,COALESCE(SUM(a.total_count),0) total,COALESCE(SUM(a.success_count),0) success, COALESCE(SUM(a.total_count-a.success_count),0) failed,COALESCE(SUM(a.slow_count),0) slow, ROUND(SUM(a.success_count)*100.0/NULLIF(SUM(a.total_count),0),2) successRate, ROUND(SUM(a.duration_us)/NULLIF(SUM(a.total_count),0)/1000,2) avgMs, ROUND(COALESCE(MAX(a.max_us),0)/1000,2) maxMs FROM sys_stat_api_day a JOIN sys_stat_endpoint e ON e.endpoint_id=a.endpoint_id WHERE GROUP BY e.endpoint_id,e.route,e.request_method,e.endpoint_name,e.module_name HAVING SUM(a.total_count)>=#{minCalls}HAVING SUM(a.total_count-a.success_count)>0 ORDER BY avgMs DESCfailed DESCtotal DESC,e.endpoint_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
